grammar_focus: Concessive 'despite' followed by a noun phrase, then a main clause
explanation: The noun phrase 'the high cost of the research' packs an idea into a single noun group, which is typical of academic style. 'Despite' signals contrast, so the main clause must show the action that happens in spite of the cost.
